description: This file defines a class 'FormatWithJobCategory' that implements the 'ValueFormatter' interface. It provides functionality to format entity values into job category names by retrieving the job category based on an ID via the 'JobCategoryService'. It includes methods for fetching the formatted value and lazily initializing the service.

classes.name: FormatWithJobCategory
classes.description: Implements 'ValueFormatter' to provide a formatted string of a job category based on entity value.

methods.name: getFormattedValue
methods.description: Returns the name of the job category corresponding to the provided entity value (ID), or null if not found.

methods.name: getJobCategoryService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns an instance of 'JobCategoryService'.
